analysis.insight_summary: Users seek to control several [product_name] devices using a single web-based application, but the default web server setup allows only individual sessions for each device. Workarounds mentioned include designating one module as a 'main' controller or integrating third-party solutions like AWS cloud and Node-Red for unified management. This highlights current limitations in built-in multi-device integration and control.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would like to manage and monitor several [product_name] modules from one central web application on the local network, making integration straightforward and allowing for graphical or programmatic control through custom tools.
